column1: # The components of this repository, by path (docs/92-release.md "Versions"; .github/scripts/changes.sh).
# One `<component>\t<pattern>` line each; a pattern is a shell `case` glob over the path from the
# repository's root, in which `*` crosses `/`. The first line that matches a path names its component;
# a path no line matches, and the component `all`, run every job.
# `@core <component>`: the component whose change reaches every other (each plugin is tested over it).
# `@flag <name>\t<pattern>`: a pull request's narrower question, true when a changed path matches (or the
# pull request is from or into a release branch): `zed_real`, whether the real Zed runs; `packaging`, whether the
# server: everything the payload is built from, and the tests and tools of the server.
# The editor plugins, each tested over the payload of the server it is changed against.
# The workflows, the actions and the pins every job runs with.
